title: UAP hosts inter-university photography exhibition ‘Beyond the Frames – Season 2’
description: University of Asia Pacific (UAP) is hosting the inter-university photography exhibition "Beyond the Frames – Season 2", bringing together young photographers from universities across Bangladesh on a common platform to showcase their creativity, perspectives and stories through photography. The two-day exhibition was inaugurated today (7 October) at UAP Plaza and will continue tomorrow (8 October), according to the press release.
